name: RORTEX
subtitle: Clustered multi-motor actuator
summary: A three-motor actuator concept for humanoid joints, bringing mechanics, custom motor control, and transmission design together.
overview: RORTEX explores a clustered multi-motor quasi-direct-drive architecture and harmonic/cycloidal transmission ideas. The current PCB baseline brings together three FOC channels and four SPI encoder interfaces.
current_state: The three-channel PCB is reported to pass EasyEDA DRC. Electrical, thermal, fabrication, and output-performance validation remain open. The 50 N·m peak torque figure is a design target, not a measured rating.
highlights: Three FOC motor-control channels and four SPI encoder interfaces.
A shared buck converter is the selected low-voltage supply direction.
STM32G491RE control planning, transmission exploration, and power-path review.
next_focus: Complete electrical and thermal review, validate the power stage, and establish measured actuator performance.
sources: RORTEX project history and current three-FOC PCB baseline
